model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в средните стойности на скритите състояния спрямо броя на слоевете в една невронна мрежа.

Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и има линейна скала, която се простира от 0 до 22 с етикети през интервали от 5. 

Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и също има линейна скала, като се простира от 0 до 4 с числови етикети.

На графиката са представени три линии:
- Първата линия е с цвят светло синьо, пунктиран стил и кръгче маркер. Тя започва близо до 0 на слой 0 и се увеличава до около 4.2 на слой 22.
- Втората линия е с цвят оранжев, пунктиран стил и кръгче маркер. Тя започва близо до 0 на слой 0 и постепенно се увеличава до около 0.1 на слой 22.
- Третата линия е с цвят зелен, плътен стил и няма видими маркери. Тя остава близо до 0 за всички слоеве, като лека промяна може да се види само след слой 18.

Средните стойности за всяка линия са дадени в легендата: 
- Light Blue line: avg 0.71
- Orange line: avg 0.05
- Green line: avg 0.04.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The line graph illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers, comparing three distinct conditions. 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale with numerical values ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. 

The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and also employs a linear scale, with values spanning from 0 to 4, marked at intervals of 1.

The graph comprises three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," a yellow dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate," and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline." The blue dashed line starts near 0 at layer 0, exhibits a slight increase up to layer 10, then more pronouncedly increases with significant jumps around layers 18 and 22, reaching approximately 4 at layer 22. The yellow dotted line and green solid line both start near 0 at layer 0 and remain relatively stable with minimal fluctuation, ending near 0 at layer 22.
model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the hidden state mean across different layers for three lines. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 25 and is in units of layer number, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 4 and is in units of absolute mean, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a dashed blue line representing the "hidden state mean before gate" with an average of 0.71, a dotted orange line representing the "hidden state mean after gate" with an average of 0.05, and a solid green line representing the "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average of 0.04. The blue line starts near 0 at layer 0 and increases steadily to around 0.5 at layer 10, then jumps to about 3.8 at layer 23. The orange and green lines remain relatively flat, starting and ending near 0, with minimal fluctuation across the layers.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt den Vergleich der durchschnittlichen absoluten Mittelwerte der versteckten Zustände vor und nach dem Gate sowie der Baseline über verschiedene Schichten. Die x-Achse stellt die Schicht dar und ist linear skaliert, mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis ungefähr 23. Die y-Achse stellt den absoluten Mittelwert dar, ist ebenfalls linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 4. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie zeigt den durchschnittlichen Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände vor dem Gate mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,71, beginnend bei etwa 0,2 und endend bei etwa 4. Die orange gepunktete Linie zeigt den durchschnittlichen Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände nach dem Gate mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,05 und bleibt über die gesamte x-Achse nahe 0. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie zeigt den durchschnittlichen Mittelwert der versteckten Zustände der Baseline mit einem Durchschnitt von 0,04 und bleibt ebenfalls über die gesamte x-Achse nahe 0.
